text.text: Plan the course, produce lessons module by module, enrol students and time your launches. Open Production for what still needs filming.
Students finish courses when someone notices they have gone quiet. A short Friday check does more than any extra video.
Reply to questions within one working day.
Check students stuck under 25 percent progress each Friday.
Refund requests: answer kindly and process in two days.
Open the student table sorted by Progress and look at the lowest active rows.
Send each a short message that names the last lesson they finished.
Log anything they were stuck on in the student notes; those become the next lesson ideas.
If a student wants a refund
Thank them, process it within two days, and set the student to Refunded. Ask one question about what they expected; the answer improves the sales page.
